decks.notes: This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and potent burn spells. With a mix of powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, alongside efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Path to Exile, the deck can quickly apply pressure while controlling the board. Utilizing Ranger-Captain of Eos to tutor for key creatures and Goblin Bombardment for additional reach, the deck seeks to close out the game swiftly before the opponent can stabilize. Additionally, the deck includes mana-fixing lands to ensure consistency in casting its spells.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on a strong aggressive strategy, utilizing companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional value. The deck includes powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ocelot Pride, supported by cards like Amped Raptor and Orcish Bowmasters. Thoughtseize helps disrupt opponents' plans while Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional reach. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Static Prison and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary to control the board. The mana base is optimized for consistency with cards like Marsh Flats and Arid Mesa.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures to create a combo win condition. The deck uses cards like Chord of Calling and Summoner's Pact to search for specific creatures like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Thassa's Oracle. By using cards like Urza's Saga and Shuko to tutor for key pieces, the deck can quickly assemble the combo to win the game. Additionally, cards like Arboreal Grazer and Wall of Roots help ramp mana to cast important spells, while cards like Springheart Nantuko provide protection for key creatures. Overall, the deck aims for a versatile toolbox strategy to outmaneuver opponents.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities in combination with Chord of Calling and Urza's Saga to create a toolbox of options to efficiently answer opponent's threats and advance its own game plan. The inclusion of cards like Summoner's Pact, Boseiju, Who Endures, and Pendelhaven enhance the deck's ability to find and protect key pieces. The deck is designed to be adaptable and responsive to different situations, making it a versatile and powerful combo deck in the Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on using a toolbox of creatures to assemble a combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Outrider en-Kor and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to set up the combo, while also including cards like Springheart Nantuko and Teferi, Time Raveler for additional support and protection. The deck also includes various lands and spells to help search for key creatures, protect them, and generate mana to execute the combo efficiently.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting opponent's strategies through a combination of countermagic, hand disruption, and removal spells. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Murktide Regent to establish a clock and finish the game. The deck aims to control the game through a mix of reactive spells and proactive threats, while leveraging cards like Subtlety and Archmage's Charm for added versatility. With a strong mana base and a variety of tools to handle different situations, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in the long game.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to deal additional damage and control the battlefield. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana ramp and flexibility. With a mix of efficient creatures and powerful spells, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain that pressure throughout the game.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through hand disruption, removal spells, and graveyard hate. It leverages cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Nihil Spellbomb to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga provides additional value and card advantage. The deck also includes efficient threats like Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief to apply pressure while still maintaining control of the game. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through a combination of disruption and efficient threats.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures to combo off with Chord of Calling and Finale of Devastation to find key pieces like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Springheart Nantuko. It uses tutors like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures to search for specific creatures or combo pieces, while also utilizing cards like Wall of Roots and Birds of Paradise for mana acceleration. The deck aims to have a versatile toolkit of creatures that can adapt to various situations and win through a powerful combo finish.

This deck focuses on utilizing control spells and cards like The One Ring to manipulate and control the game. It uses a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily building up its own resources. The deck aims to establish board control and outvalue the opponent by carefully managing its resources and responding to threats efficiently. The goal is to maintain dominance over the game by dictating the pace and direction of play.

The deck focuses on generating fast mana with rituals and medallions to cast multiple spells in a single turn, aiming to storm off and win through a combination of Ral, Monsoon Mage's abilities and burn spells like Grapeshot. The deck includes cards like Past in Flames to recur spells from the graveyard and Wrenn's Resolve to protect key pieces. The combo can be set up with Wish to fetch specific cards from the sideboard. Glimpse the Impossible and Questing Druid provide additional ways to generate extra mana to power through the combo.

This deck focuses on quickly generating mana through rituals and medallions to cast a high number of cheap spells in order to storm off with Ral, Monsoon Mage or Flame of Anor, generating an overwhelming amount of damage or card advantage. The deck also includes wish effects like Glimpse the Impossible to tutor for key cards, as well as ways to recur spells like Past in Flames to continue the combo. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana ramp and a potential late-game payoff.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Amulet of Vigor, allowing you to play powerful cards like Primeval Titan and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove early on. The deck then aims to assemble the "The One Ring" combo, which combines Malevolent Rumble with The Mycosynth Gardens to create a repeatable way to deal damage to your opponent. With the help of Urza's Saga and various land cards, you can search for crucial pieces of the combo and overwhelm your opponent with a powerful board presence.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also utilizing removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to keep the opponent's board in check. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to close out games quickly. Ranger-Captain of Eos helps tutor for key creatures, while Arena of Glory provides additional support for the aggressive plan. With a mix of efficient threats and removal, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine) to generate large amounts of colorless mana quickly. This mana is then used to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures and various control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing cards like All Is Dust, Thought-Knot Seer, and Karn, the Great Creator to limit the opponent's options and eventually overwhelm them with big threats like World Breaker and Devourer of Destiny.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key concept revolves around utilizing low-cost creatures like Amped Raptor and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, to apply constant pressure on the opponent. Additionally, cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge provide additional reach and removal options. With a strong curve and efficient threats, this deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of creature damage and burn spells.
